data.title: User Registration
data.description: As a new user, I want to register an account, so that I can access the system
acceptanceCriteria: WHEN user provides valid email and password THEN account is created
WHEN user provides invalid email THEN validation error is shown
WHEN user provides weak password THEN password strength requirements are displayed

data.title: User Login
data.description: As a registered user, I want to login to my account, so that I can access my data
acceptanceCriteria: WHEN user provides correct credentials THEN they are logged in
WHEN user provides incorrect credentials THEN error message is shown
WHEN user account is locked THEN appropriate message is displayed

data.title: Product Creation
data.description: As an admin, I want to create new products, so that I can manage inventory
acceptanceCriteria: WHEN admin provides valid product data THEN product is created
WHEN admin provides invalid data THEN validation errors are shown
WHEN product is created THEN it appears in product catalog

data.title: Password Reset
data.description: As a user, I want to reset my password, so that I can regain access to my account
acceptanceCriteria: WHEN user requests password reset THEN email is sent with reset link
WHEN user clicks reset link THEN password reset form is displayed
WHEN user sets new password THEN account is updated and user can login

data.title: Product Search
data.description: As a user, I want to search for products, so that I can find items to borrow
acceptanceCriteria: WHEN user enters search term THEN relevant products are displayed
WHEN user applies filters THEN results are filtered accordingly
WHEN no results found THEN helpful message is shown
